lesson.summary: A fan-out sweep run with a tracked-files-only grep cannot see the files the change adds
lesson.synthesized_rule: When sweeping for survivors of a contract change, use a grep that includes UNTRACKED files. A tracked-files-only grep is blind to exactly the files the change is adding -- the changelog, history and feedback entries a ship pipeline creates -- and those are the files most likely to restate the contract and the most user-visible. Fewer hits reads as progress rather than as a narrower search, so the failure is self-concealing. State the tool in the rule, not just the intent.
